subject.title: BL-shipping-invoices-08: firma obsoleta en el pie de las facturas

question: What approved ES and ENG footer assets, signer details, or no-signature policy should replace the current embedded commercial-invoice signature?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but the actual signer/seal/footer content is a legal and business approval that cannot be inferred safely from the repository.

options.title: Use approved replacement footers
options.body: Provide or approve the two ES/ENG footer PNG/base64 assets and let a narrow PR replace the constants and verify rendered PDFs.

options.title: Regenerate from approved signer data
options.body: Provide the approved signer name, role, signature/seal source, and layout requirements so the footers can be regenerated before code changes.

options.title: Remove signature from the footer
options.body: If legal approves a no-signature footer, document that decision and replace both images with approved no-signature versions.

recommendation.title: Use approved replacement footers
recommendation.body: Provide or approve the two ES/ENG footer PNG/base64 assets and let a narrow PR replace the constants and verify rendered PDFs.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the BL shipping/invoices spec that surfaced the divergence and is the clearest current routing point for owner-approved invoice rules.
